texts.Why are you interested in Fireworks AI?: Candid disclosure first: this application was prepared by my own Claude agent fleet under my direction, from my verified bio - building and operating that fleet in public is my core work (github.com/tonydzi). Fireworks is the draw because I am your customer profile. I run a production multi-machine agent fleet in Palo Alto and spend my days on inference cost, latency and model choice, so I can talk to an engineering buyer without a script. My pipeline background is literal, not aspirational: 10,000+ founder calls and 2,000+ institutional-investor calls at Platinum VC & Incubator, a self-written CRM that up to 30 operators used daily, and every repeatable outbound motion automated - first with that CRM, today with AI agents. I also run a 169k-subscriber AI channel and a 500+ practitioner community in Palo Alto, which is where developer-led pipeline actually comes from.
